summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new PayPal sandbox payments integration. 16/16 backend pytest cases pass against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (real PayPal sandbox OAuth + order creation). Frontend tested with renter@test.com via Playwright on the public URL: /payment/cancel + /payment/success error state + full /document-service flow incl. bundle discount banner, dynamic price, gated PayPal buttons, and PayPal Smart Buttons iframe successfully mounted (title='PayPal'). No critical issues found.

tested_flows.POST /api/payments/orders document_servi: PASS — amount=150.0 USD, status=created, paypal_order_id present, persisted (verified via GET /payments/orders/{id})
tested_flows.POST /api/payments/orders/{id}/capture b: PASS — backend correctly wraps PayPal 4xx as 502
tested_flows./document-service: bundle discount banne: PASS — banner text 'Bundle discount applied: both services for $250 instead of $300.'
tested_flows./document-service: PayPal Smart Buttons: PASS — paypal-buttons-wrapper renders + iframe with title='PayPal' name starts with __zoid__paypal_buttons__ loads in <1s

code_review_observations: payments.py — _compute_amount is clean and server-authoritative. Bundle pricing ($250) and 2.5% sublease fee correctly enforced. Currency whitelist is USD/ILS only (EUR rejected as required).

paypal.py — REST v2 client is minimal and correct: OAuth token cached with 60s pre-expiry refresh, create_order uses CAPTURE intent + NO_SHIPPING + brand_name. amount serialized as f'{amount:.2f}' which is correct for PayPal. Description capped at 127 chars.

Capture endpoint correctly transitions order status: created -> captured | failed and persists captured_at + paypal_capture. Status transitions also handle non-COMPLETED captures (sets lowercased pp_status).
ACL: GET /payments/orders/{id} and capture both check user_id == auth user_id with admin override; verified working (403 on cross-user access).

MINOR: capture_payment_order does not handle the case where an HTTPException (403/404) accidentally gets turned into 502 by the broad `except Exception` because HTTPException would be raised before the try/except wrapping paypal.capture_order. Verified — the HTTPException for 'Not your order' is raised before the try block, so this is fine.

MINOR: send_payment_confirmation_email is awaited but if it raises, the entire capture endpoint will 500 even though the payment already succeeded. Consider wrapping email sends in try/except so a transient SMTP failure doesn't appear as a failed payment to the user.

MINOR: _compute_amount for sublease_booking uses currency from metadata, but PayPal will fail if the merchant account doesn't support that currency. Sandbox is USD-only by default — ILS sublease orders may fail at PayPal level. Worth a follow-up validation.

MINOR (frontend): PayPalCheckout.jsx onApprove fetches the entire /payments/my list to find the matching internal id by paypal_order_id. With many orders this is O(n) network. A dedicated endpoint like POST /payments/orders/by-paypal-id/{pp_id}/capture would be cleaner.

MINOR (frontend): DocumentService.js stores sensitive 'tenant_id' (likely Israeli national ID) in metadata.details.tenant_id and posts it to backend; backend stores it in db.document_services.details. Acceptable but flag for PII handling/encryption in production.
action_items: (MINOR) Wrap send_payment_confirmation_email calls in try/except inside capture_payment_order so an email failure doesn't 500 a successful capture.
(MINOR) Consider preventing ILS sublease orders if the PayPal sandbox merchant doesn't support ILS — currently the create_order would fail at PayPal level returning 502.
(OPTIONAL) Add a POST /payments/orders/by-paypal-id/{pp_id}/capture shortcut to avoid the /payments/my round-trip in PayPalCheckout.onApprove.
(OPTIONAL/Security) Document/encrypt PII (tenant_id national ID) stored in db.document_services.details before going live.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all critical render/integration checks pass; PayPal iframe successfully mounts

test_credentials: Used renter@test.com / Test1234! and owner@test.com / Test1234! per /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Tests create real orders in the `orders` collection (status='created') and against the real PayPal sandbox; cleanup is not required as orders never get captured (sandbox UI approval skipped). If desired, drop documents where metadata.tenant_name='TEST Tenant' or 'TEST Bundle'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_payments.py is reusable for regression. Renter login endpoint is /api/auth/login returning {access_token, user}. PayPal Smart Buttons mount correctly under data-testid='paypal-buttons-wrapper' as an iframe with title='PayPal' and name starting with '__zoid__paypal_buttons__' — do NOT click into that iframe (requires real sandbox buyer login in popup). The capture endpoint cannot be tested end-to-end via curl alone; expect 502 before buyer approval. Auth login flow has a slow first paint (~3-4s) on /auth/login — wait at least 4s before selecting form fields. Frontend route is /auth/login (not /auth).
